274757|21ab523d.name: Temple Highguard
274757|21ab523d.text: Here in Darnassus you will find skilled trainers who have perfected the skills of their chosen class through ages of training and dedication.  I will guide you to one who can become your mentor, you have but to name your chosen path.

274757|4979e51a.name: Temple Highguard
274757|4979e51a.text: Ever vigilant in their protection of the natural world, the druids are guided by Arch $C Fandral Staghelm who resides in the Cenarion Enclave.  You will find him and the other $C trainers in the northern section of Darnassus.

274757|ce424d00.name: Temple Highguard
274757|ce424d00.text: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?

274757|d3a25a4e.name: Temple Highguard
274757|d3a25a4e.text: Alegorn is a masterful chef who has had centuries with which to perfect his cooking.  You should consider yourself blessed should he decide to teach you.  If you believe you are worthy, you can find him in the Craftsmen's Terrace.

274757|e07232c6.name: Temple Highguard
274757|e07232c6.text: Here among the craftsmen of Darnassus, there is a millenium of knowledge for the benefit of your chosen craft.  Now tell me, which craft do you find the most intriguing?

7999|ccf70497.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
7999|ccf70497.text:
It pleases me greatly to at last meet one of your people. I've heard much of the shen'dorei and your long history, and  I am glad to see our cousins return home to Kalimdor at long last.

I confess that our people have a... complicated relationship with the Highborne. Some amongst the Night Elves are quick to distrust those of Highborne descent such as those in your High Order. However, you have my assurance that you will be shown the utmost respect while a guest in our city.

Please, make yourself at home here. I'd encourage you to explore and familiarize yourself with our culture. It is, after all, your culture as well in a way.

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

22-progress.name: Salma Saldean
22-progress.text: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-progress.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

38-progress.name: Salma Saldean
38-progress.text:
Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-progress.title: Westfall Stew

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

94914-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
94914-complete.text: Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young $c.
94914-complete.title: Moonglade

98067-accept.name: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade
98067-accept.text:
General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.

Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.
98067-accept.title: Eyes of the Sentinels
